about: Every leaf has one role: source, derived, observed or foreign. A capsule names roles as claims on
leaf-role/<name>; a name matches a whole segment, and *<end> matches a segment that ends with <end>.
Foreign outranks derived, derived outranks observed, and a leaf no claim names is source.
It got its own file because a take on 2026-09-17 landed 11 leaves for 5: the build output, the build info
and two linked packages entered the moved set as if they were source.
The star came the same day: a store and an extension share the spelling .bound, and reading every dotted
name as an ending would have made each claim file of the tree observed, and invisible to the judge.
